category: IP to ASN and country database download

free_tier.stated: free IP to ASN and IP to country database files, updated hourly: IPv4, IPv6 and combined TSV files in gzip, no account; the hosted API was phased out on December 31, 2020
free_tier.notes: the IPv4 to ASN file ip2asn-v4.tsv.gz was 8,697,031 bytes with HTTP 200 when probed.

retention.stated: each file is the current snapshot; the page says it is updated hourly

egress.terms: not applicable: static files served through Cloudflare with no published meter

interface_detail: plain HTTPS download of gzip-compressed TSV files from https://iptoasn.com/data/ (ip2asn-v4, ip2asn-v4-u32, ip2country-v4, ip2country-v4-u32, ip2asn-v6, ip2country-v6 and ip2asn-combined) with the columns range_start, range_end, AS_number, country_code, AS_description; the interface vocabulary has no term for a file download (https-download)
tooling: curl or wget and gunzip, any TSV reader or SQL loader; the author's iptoasn-webservice source turns the files into a lookup API, which the user installs and runs on a rented or free machine and which is the last resort after the downloads
chaining: The one free ASN and country mapping with no account and no per-request limit, usable as a local join table in a pipeline. Bulk path: the files themselves, IPv4 to ASN 8,697,031 bytes gzipped.
binding_note: static files with no published download limit.
reliability_note: the hosted API was phased out on 2020-12-31 due to increasing traffic; ip2asn-v4.tsv.gz had Last-Modified Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:38:42 GMT in an answer dated Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:42:50 GMT, while the page says the data is updated hourly
confidence_note: The IPv4 to ASN file was downloaded in full on 2026-11-02 (HTTP 200, 8,697,031 bytes) and the page was quoted; the other files were not downloaded and the hourly update claim was observed once, not tracked.
